metadata.name: heads_or_tails
metadata.description: Heads or Tails — FIFO coin-flip game with ORAO VRF and permissionless settlement

instructions.name: advance_head
docs: Permissionless hole skipping. Advances one queue head past a
provably inactive entry. Moves no funds.

instructions.name: advance_head_room
docs: V2: permissionless hole skipping within ONE tier/room.

instructions.name: cancel_queue_entry
docs: Refund an unmatched entry exactly and free the wallet for re-entry.

instructions.name: cancel_queue_entry_room
docs: V2: refund an unmatched tier-scoped entry exactly.

instructions.name: init_room
docs: V2: create a tier-scoped room. Admin only. Supported: $1, $10.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the game config and the program-controlled token vault.

instructions.name: initialize_hts
docs: Owner-authorized isolated HTS namespace; legacy config must already be paused.

instructions.name: join_queue
docs: Stake the exact token amount and enqueue it on `side`.
`sequence` must equal the current tail of that side (read from
GameConfig); pass it explicitly so the entry PDA is deterministic.

instructions.name: join_queue_room
docs: V2: stake into a tier-scoped room queue. `sequence` must equal the
room's current tail for `side`. Global one-active rule preserved.

instructions.name: match_next
docs: Permissionless FIFO matcher. Matches the two current queue heads and
requests ORAO VRF exactly once. `match_id` must equal
`config.total_matches`. Supply a fresh unpredictable nonce for each
new attempt; an existing ORAO request is never adopted.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Payer for the match account, the VRF request account and fees. Anyone.

accounts.name: vrf_network_state
docs: the VRF program bumps its request counter on each request.

accounts.name: vrf_treasury
docs: Mutable: it receives the request fee.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Payer for the match account, the VRF request account and fees. Anyone.

instructions.name: match_next_room
docs: V2: permissionless FIFO matcher within ONE tier/room. `match_id` must
equal global `config.total_matches`. Supply a fresh unpredictable nonce.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Payer for the match account, the VRF request account and fees. Anyone.

instructions.name: migrate_player_state
docs: V2 migration: expand a pre-V2 PlayerState to the tier-aware layout.
Idle-only is trivially safe; active legacy positions default to $1
(the only room that existed pre-V2). Settled history is untouched.

accounts.name: player_owner
docs: player field inside the handler.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Normal owner transfer. The CURRENT owner signs. Prefer a two-step
propose/accept upgrade later; this keeps the account layout unchanged.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause or unpause new queue joins. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_room_active
docs: V2: enable/disable a tier-scoped room. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_tier_active
docs: Enable or disable a tier. Only tier 1 exists in V1. Admin only.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller only pays fees/geometry. Never the payout destination.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: binding verified in handler.

accounts.name: winner_tokens
docs: owner and mint verified in handler.

instructions.name: settle_match
docs: Permissionless settlement. Anyone may call it (winner, loser, keeper);
the program alone derives the result, the winner, the destination and
the amount from verified on-chain state.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller only pays fees/geometry. Never the payout destination.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: binding verified in handler.

accounts.name: winner_tokens
docs: owner and mint verified in handler.

types.name: EntryStatus
docs: Queue entry lifecycle. Cancelled entries leave holes that the matcher
must provably skip via on-chain account validation.

types.name: FlipResult
docs: Flip outcome derived deterministically from fulfilled VRF bytes.

types.name: GameConfig
docs: Global game configuration. The single source of queue head/next indices,
so FIFO order is authoritative on-chain.

types.name: Match
docs: A matched pair awaiting randomness and settlement.

fields.name: seed
docs: Replay-resistant VRF seed, unique per match.

fields.name: result
docs: 0 = HEADS, 1 = TAILS.

types.name: MatchState
docs: Match lifecycle. Randomness is observed and consumed atomically inside
`settle_match`, so no intermediate state is required.

types.name: PlayerState
docs: Per-wallet activity guard. V1 allows exactly one active queue entry or
one unresolved match per wallet — V2 keeps the same global rule across
ALL rooms (a wallet may NOT sit in $1 and $10 simultaneously).
`queued_tier_usd` / `match_tier_usd` give the room context needed to
recover state correctly (0 = none/legacy-idle, 1 = $1 legacy default).

types.name: QueueEntry
docs: One FIFO queue slot. PDAs are deterministic in (side, sequence), so any
client can resolve the current head address off-chain.
NOTE: legacy V1 global queue. Preserved for settled-history and drain;
new rooms use RoomQueueEntry below with tier-scoped PDAs.

types.name: RoomQueueEntry
docs: Tier-scoped FIFO queue slot. PDA:
["queue", tier_usd_byte, side_byte, sequence_le_bytes].
A $1 HEADS entry can NEVER match a $10 TAILS entry: matching only pairs
entries from the SAME RoomState/tier.

types.name: RoomState
docs: Tier-scoped room state: independent FIFO pointers per real room.
PDA: ["room", tier_usd_byte]. `total_matches` stays global in GameConfig.
